description:
Our Program:
The A-Class Fitness Affiliate Program gives you the opportunity to earn generous commissions by promoting world-class online personal training, personalized programs, and subscription-based results systems. With every client you refer, you earn 15% lifetime commissions for the client — and 10% lifetime recurring commissions every month they stay subscribed to any subscription program. 


Tools: affiliate links, marketing content, email scripts, banners, images, videos, quality dashboard, and more.

Who can apply?
Anyone is welcome to apply. You do not need a large following — if you’re passionate about fitness, lifestyle content, bloggers, or simply helping people improve, you’re eligible. However: “We only sell to Canada, United States, United Kingdom, and Australia. Affiliates may be located anywhere, but their audience must include one or more of these regions.”

Affiliates get access to:
  • Branded logos
  • Approved messaging
  • Image & Video assets
  • Banners
  • Product descriptions
  • Promotional materials
  • Affiliates can also request certain marketing materials. Which will be reviewed before possible approval.
Everything you need to promote the brand professionally.
payout_period:
Payouts are processed once per month, between the 1st and 5th.
All approved commissions from the previous month are sent during this window.
Payments are issued manually via PayPal or Wise based on the payout method you provide in your affiliate account.

This Is (16130267 Canada Inc. Acting As A-Class Fitness) Affiliate Program – Terms of Service

Last Updated: November 2025

Welcome to the A-Class Fitness Affiliate Program (“Program”).

By joining the Program, you (“Affiliate”) agree to comply with the following Terms of Service.

If you do not agree to these terms, you are not permitted to participate.

1. Program Eligibility & Approval

A-Class Fitness (“we,” “us,” “merchant”) reserves the right to approve or reject any affiliate application at our sole discretion.

We may deny applications for reasons including, but not limited to:

  • Incomplete or inaccurate information
  • Fraud concerns
  • Content that conflicts with our brand (hate speech, adult content, scams, etc.)
  • Misleading or unethical marketing practices

Applicants have no legal claim against A-Class Fitness for being rejected.

2. Affiliate Links, Tracking & Coupons

2.1 Affiliate Links

  • Your personal affiliate link is generated automatically.
  • When multiple affiliate links are clicked, the most recent click receives the attribution.
  • Tracking is powered by cookies and UpPromote’s tracking system.

2.2 Coupons

  • Some affiliates may receive a custom coupon code.
  • If both a link and a coupon are used in the same order, no double commission is awarded (one commission per order).
  • Affiliates may not create or distribute unapproved discount codes.
  • Affiliates must not misrepresent discounts.
  • Some affiliate programs already have auto coupons enabled on checkout so affiliates will not get separate coupons. They will be allowed to promote the coupon to their audience. Kindly refer to your dashboard and affiliate program for auto coupon rate.

2.3 Allowed Promotion Channels

Affiliates may promote their link through:

  • Social media platforms
  • Blogs and websites they own
  • Private communities they manage
  • Email lists with proper consent
  • Offline channels (flyers, business cards, etc.)

2.4 Prohibited Promotion Methods

Affiliates may NOT:

  • Run ads targeting A-Class Fitness branded keywords
  • Pretend to be A-Class Fitness or impersonate staff
  • Spam, mass-message, or use any unsolicited promotion
  • Post discounts on coupon-farm websites
  • Use misleading, fraudulent, or deceptive practices
  • Use their own link to purchase for themselves (self-referrals)

Any violation may result in account suspension and loss of commissions.

3. Commissions & Payments

3.1 Commission Structure

Affiliates earn commissions according to the Program’s official rate which they choose to join, including:

  • Commission on coaching purchases, session packages, and one-time programs
  • Commission excludes: taxes, shipping, tips, fees, refunds, and chargebacks

3.2 Recurring Subscription Commissions

Recurring commissions apply only to subscriptions that rebill through our integrated subscription provider (Appstle).

If a subscriber cancels, pauses, or fails payment, recurring commissions stop.

3.3 Minimum Payout & Payment Method

  • Affiliates must meet the minimum payout threshold stated in their dashboard.
  • Payouts are made via the payment methods we support (e.g., PayPal, Wise Business, Email Transfer, and Bank Transfer).
  • Affiliates are responsible for ensuring accurate payment details.

3.4 Payment Timing

  • Commissions are only paid on completed and non-refunded transactions.
  • Orders that charge back, get declined, or refunded will not be paid.

3.5 Fraud Review

A-Class Fitness reserves the right to:

  • Review every referral
  • Reject commissions that appear fraudulent
  • Hold commissions until verification is complete

4. Marketing Materials

We may provide approved marketing materials such as:

  • Logos
  • Banners
  • Social media assets
  • Sales graphics
  • Testimonials
  • Brand guidelines

These materials are for affiliate promotional use only and may not be altered without permission.

5. Cookies & Tracking Window

  • Tracking relies on browser cookies.
  • If a user blocks or deletes cookies, we may not be able to track the referral.
  • Cookie duration is stated on the Program registration page.
  • Any order placed during the cookie period (after the first click) will attribute to the affiliate unless another affiliate’s link is clicked later.

6. Prohibited Activities

The following behaviors are strictly forbidden:

  • Self-referrals
  • Creating fake accounts or fake orders
  • Using bots, automated traffic, or incentivized clicks
  • Posting harmful, discriminatory, or illegal content
  • Manipulating commissions or exploiting loopholes
  • Affiliate stacking (creating multiple affiliate accounts)

Violation may result in immediate termination and forfeiture of commissions.

7. Removal or Termination

7.1 Affiliate-Requested Removal

Affiliates may request account removal at any time by contacting:

📧 support@aclassfitness.com

Upon removal:

  • All future unpaid commissions will be void
  • Lifetime and recurring commissions will stop immediately

7.2 Merchant-Initiated Termination

We may terminate any affiliate without notice if the affiliate:

  • Violates these Terms
  • Engages in fraud
  • Damages our brand
  • Abuses promotional tools
  • Engages in unethical sales behavior

All unpaid commissions may be forfeited at our discretion.

8. Taxes

Affiliates are responsible for paying any taxes based on earnings as required by their local laws.

U.S. affiliates may be required to submit tax documents (e.g., W-9/1099-NEC) if applicable.

9. Limitation of Liability

A-Class Fitness is not liable for:

  • Loss of commissions due to technical issues (e.g., cookie deletion, ad blockers)
  • Loss of income, profits, or data
  • Any errors in the affiliate’s promotional efforts

Our program is offered “as is” and may be updated, paused, or discontinued at any time.

10. Modifications to the Program

A-Class Fitness may update these Terms at any time.

Continued participation in the Program after changes are made constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

11. Contact

For questions or support:

📧 support@aclassfitness.com

By joining the A-Class Fitness Affiliate Program, you acknowledge and agree to all terms above.
